searchText: b"h phase three: final critique before execution the awtsmoos gives each candidate one honest trial while production remains the guarded shore; awtsmoos.com compares timing, truth, and movement before allowing any further door. final questions 1. does the local generated bundle actually contain the deferred scheduler boundary described by its tests? 2. does that scheduler import resolve when served from the repository proof server? 3. does essential readiness settle before the twenty second timeout? 4. does full readiness return without blocking the launcher promise? 5. does the bootstrap minimap mount once and transfer ownership once? 6. does rich ui preserve inventory and equipment state instead of replacing it destructively? 7. does local tab multiplayer show both players in both pages? 8. does optional chat mount without timer throttling in local tab mode? 9. does server style transport defer chat without harming readiness or movement? 10. does the candidate reduce cold start time relative to the 11.138 second production proof? 11. are request counts and javascript bytes lower without new 404s? 12. does the candidate preserve the exact drive model urls? 13. does it avoid altering the route shell hardening? 14. are all current source files below 120 lines? 15. does every changed file have a corresponding behavioral proof? 16. is the local compact artifact reproducible from current source? 17. are any changes owned by another active process? 18. can the candidate be validated without writing or regenerating anything? 19. can failures be reported without touching the candidate? 20. is there any reason to disturb the proven production release before all answers are green? final decision the next execution pass is read only. it will run source tests, inspect exact diffs, launch the current working tree through the existing browser proof harness, record timing and runtime receipts, and compare results with production. any red gate becomes a written audit finding, not an automatic code rewrite.

searchText: b"h final execution plan the awtsmoos permits one measured trial while the deployed meadow remains untouched; awtsmoos.com records every candidate receipt before any future source may be adjusted. read only actions 1. capture git diff stat, exact changed paths, timestamps, and hashes. 2. verify the local compact artifact contains the deferred scheduler boundary expected by the native boot contract. 3. run: route shell tests; native boot contract; readiness settlement tests; feature scheduler tests; compactjs real runtime test; any bootstrap minimap tests found in the repository. 4. launch the current working tree through browserproofprocess.mjs and a fresh isolated cdp target. 5. record: time to diagnostics publication; time to essential receipt; time to playable; six system readiness; minimap count and bootstrap ownership; console exceptions; failed requests; movement distance. 6. run optionalmultiplayersurfacediagnostic.mjs against two local pages and preserve its snapshots. 7. compare candidate bytes, timing, requests, and errors with production release d77341824. 8. write an audit verdict: green candidate, candidate with blockers, or rejected candidate. forbidden actions no source rewrite. no compact regeneration. no staging. no commit. no push. no deployment. no deletion or reset of local changes. no contact with android emulator files. promotion gate a later source or deployment phase may begin only after every read only gate is green and the candidate demonstrably improves or preserves production startup, gameplay, network, minimap, chat, and movement behavior.
